exceptions.why: EXCEPTION (reported): step 2/3 cut every internal part/part boundary hard, so the BACK part's boundary row still holds the anti-aliasing mix with the FRONT part's colour (e.g. a light row of head-band colour on top of the brown collar, arm-tan dots on the tail's dark stripe). When the front part moves, that row stays behind as a dotted / light seam line. Fix that keeps the rest pose: for each back-part boundary pixel (alpha 255, 4-adjacent to an opaque front-part pixel) whose colour is > SEAM_TOL off the clean local colour of its own region (median of same-region non-boundary px within 3 px), the back pixel gets that clean colour and the FRONT layer gets a soft edge pixel there: alpha = projection of the mix on the (front colour - clean colour) line, colour un-mixed exactly for that alpha, so front-over- back reproduces the original pixel (verified: rest recomposite diff below).
